mission: Maintain a continuous supply of professional review-ready Christian media without automatically publishing unreviewed work.
priorities: Professional Master quality outranks production volume

queuePolicy.actionWhenBelowMinimum: prioritize recovery of existing exact approved masters, then produce and certify missing slots for the 14-day archive before lower-priority experiments

releaseRule: Targets are aspirational. Never lower quality, accuracy, rights, sync, thumbnail, or professional-execution standards to hit output quotas.

releaseReadinessPolicy.lateChangePolicy: Any content, media, thumbnail, caption, audio, export, title, description, or metadata change after freeze creates a new hash, invalidates approvals, and requires full re-approval.
releaseReadinessPolicy.missedGatePolicy: If the exact master is not RELEASE_READY by T-2h, miss/reschedule the slot; never render, repair, substitute media, or bypass QA at posting time.
releaseReadinessPolicy.publisherRule: Publisher approves last only after the other 49 approvals on the exact frozen hash and all QA gates PASS.
